3. First Corporate Tax Period Close (2025)Dec 31, 2025

5. Standard 9-Month Return Filing & Tax Payment DeadlineSep 30, 2026

Under Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022, your CT return must be filed and any tax due (9% on income > AED 375k) paid within 9 months of period close.

Statutory Relief Mechanism

How to Waive Your AED 10,000 Corporate Tax Penalty (7-Month Cut-Off Rule)

If your company missed its initial Corporate Tax registration deadline and incurred the AED 10,000 penalty, the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) provides a statutory mechanism for 100% Penalty Reconsideration & Waiver prior to the 7-month cut-off date (July 31, 2026).

STEP 1Obtain Corporate Tax TRN

Register company on EmaraTax portal immediately to stop ongoing non-compliance.

STEP 2Submit Return Before July 31, 2026

File your first CT return prior to the 7-month cut-off date (July 31, 2026).

STEP 3File FTA Reconsideration Form

ADVAQ Tax Agency files an official Reconsideration Request under Article 27.

STEP 4100% Fine Waived / Refunded

FTA approves waiver and credits back the AED 10,000 administrative fine.

Legal & Financial Consequences

Risks & Penalties of Missing Corporate Tax Registration

AED 10,000 Fine

Automatic administrative penalty under Cabinet Decision No. 75 of 2023 posted directly to your FTA EmaraTax portal.

Loss of SBR 0% Relief

Failure to register on time forfeits eligibility for Small Business Relief (SBR 0% tax on revenue up to AED 3 Million).

Bank Account Freeze

UAE Banks (Wio, Emirates NBD, Mashreq) require a valid Corporate Tax TRN during annual KYC review to prevent account suspension.

Trade License Block

Department of Economy & Tourism (DET) and Free Zone Authorities cross-reference FTA compliance before renewing trade licenses.

Knowledge Base

Frequently Asked Questions (UAE CT Deadlines & Waiver)

The 7-month penalty waiver cut-off date is exactly 7 months following the close of your company's tax period. For example, for a financial year ending December 31, 2024, the 7-month waiver cut-off date is July 31, 2025. If your return is submitted prior to July 31, 2025, ADVAQ can apply for a 100% FTA penalty waiver.
